[SWS_DM_01086] Triggering for snapshot record storage (configured, with up-
date)
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04205, RS_Diag_04127
⌈
If
DiagnosticMemoryDestination.typeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumeration
is set to
configured
,
DiagnosticFreezeFrame.update
is set to ’True’ and the
configured
DiagnosticFreezeFrame.trigger
is fulfilled, the DM shall collect and
store, respectively update the
snapshot record
.
⌋
